profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Systems engineer with 10+ years building production-grade web, mobile, and backend systems. I work across web (TypeScript/React), mobile (React Native, Android/Kotlin), and backend (Python/Flask, TypeScript/Node.js), using agentic development workflows to accelerate delivery for startups and enterprises. I've led teams, shipped to production, and contributed to every phase of development from architecture to deployment.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer & Founder
positions.description:
- Developed a custom Android browser forked from the Firefox open-source project, integrating new UIs with Jetpack Compose and XML views under MVVM. Built an infinite-scroll newsfeed with multiple scrollable tabs, lazy pagination, and section-based vertical scrolling. 100K downloads on Google Play.
- Built a white-label Android app for Haku's race event platform, providing branded race info. Built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and MVVM, backed by Firebase (Firestore DB, App Distribution, Cloud Storage). Automated Play Store builds and releases via GitHub Actions.
- Modernized a legacy React dashboard for a wholesale wine distributor into a mobile-responsive web app based on Figma designs. Upgraded from React 16 Class Components to React 18 with Function Components, Hooks and Context API, implemented custom drag-and-drop for mobile, built using GraphQL, Redis and PostgreSQL.
- Worked on a React Native running coach app for Android and iOS, using Gemini AI for personalized training plan and feedback on progress. Built with Expo and custom native modules in Swift and Kotlin, integrating HealthKit and Health Connect for smartwatch workout sync.
- Designed and deployed a fully automated options trading system running multiple credit-spread strategies with configurable entry filters (ADX, RSI, etc.), backed by a backtest engine achieving entry signal parity across trading sessions. Built on a ZeroMQ pub/sub architecture with Databento data streamed into Redis, a Thetadata proxy for options pricing, and Docker services for Alpaca and Interactive Brokers.
positions.insights: Skills: Github · React Native · APIs · Version Control · JavaScript · GraphQL · Python · Android · React.js

positions.title: Student Mentor
positions.description: Mentor students on coding courses, doing projects that include Python, Flask, Javascript and React.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built a React Native tablet app for self-service 3D body scanning booths integrated with 3dMD scanners, coordinating captures via WebSockets and rendering 3D avatars with Three.js.
- Developed and maintained a React web app with drag-and-drop UIs. Managed image/file upload pipelines and Cloud Storage resizing to power virtual try-on for clothing brands.
- Built a Python Flask API integrating Firebase Auth, Firestore, and Cloud Storage to support mobile and web application data.
- Hardened applications against OWASP Top 10 risks and DDoS threats by fine-tuning GCP Cloud Armor WAF rules, implementing CSP, and hardening auth flows; passed two independent third-party web security audits.
positions.insights: Skills: Github · Flask · React Native · APIs · Version Control · Python · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led a team of 4 designing, building, and deploying a critical patient-facing React application with Redux and GraphQL under HIPAA compliance, released to production on schedule.
- Shipped mobile health-tech apps across phone, tablet, and Clover Point-of-Sale hardware with shared Java/Kotlin code. Managed Play Store and Clover App Market releases via Travis CI.
- Monitored production issues using LogRocket and New Relic, addressing problems promptly.
- Interviewed and mentored 10+ engineering candidates.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description:
- Built an internal QA dashboard from scratch using React, Redux, GraphQL Apollo, Prisma, and PostgreSQL for automated test management and reporting.
- Experience working with build servers, creating and maintaining deployment/testing pipelines, using CircleCI, Travis CI, Bamboo and Jenkins.
- Developed automated UI test suites for Web (Selenium, Ranorex, C#, Python) and Android (Appium, Espresso) applications.

positions.title: Network Services Tech
positions.description:
- Provided support for network and telephony systems for all campuses.
- Participated in the upgrade of voicemail and phone systems in multiple campuses, being involved in every aspect of the upgrade from technical to project management and user training to support.
- Created Python scripts used to automate complex configuration changes in over 200 Cisco network switches being installed, across multiple campuses.
- Automated the parsing and transferring of voicemail and phone number accounts out of a legacy PBX system(early 90s) using scripts created in Procomm Plus with ASPECT scripting language for data extraction and Java for cleaning/formatting the data for the new system.

positions.title: Technical Support Specialist
positions.description: - Provided technical support for home and small business clients.
